字体、主题即时生效；较大字号会同步增加控件高度。: Language, font and theme apply immediately. Larger fonts increase control heights.
SSAO 可改善凹凸阴影，同时增加 GPU 开销。: SSAO improves surface shading and increases GPU usage.
0 表示关闭历史记录。拆分撤销和较大的历史深度会增加内存占用。: 0 disables history. Split undo and larger history limits use more memory.
默认在后台运行。开启后显示 Host 日志控制台；下次启动程序时生效。已运行的: Runs in the background by default. Enable to show the Host log console on the next launch. Existing Hosts are reused; this option does not restart the service.
关闭 Host 控制台会结束后端服务，使用过程中请保持它运行。: Closing the Host console stops the backend service. Keep it running while using the application.
设置自动保存并即时生效: Settings are saved automatically and apply immediately
设置已保存，Host 控制台显示将在下次启动时生效: Saved. Host console visibility applies on the next launch
参数“{0}”不能小于 {1}，已调整为 {2}。: Parameter “{0}” cannot be less than {1}. Adjusted to {2}.
交互插件只显示在主窗口右侧。插件的全部配置在这里修改。: Interactive plugins appear in the right panel. Edit all plugin settings here.
安装包后需手动启用。停用后的重新启用和版本更新需重启；加载的 DLL 不进行热卸: Enable packages after installation. Re-enabling or updating loaded plugins requires a restart; loaded DLLs are not hot-unloaded.
插件配置集中在此窗口中修改: Edit all plugin settings in this window
读取已取消或超时: Model loading cancelled or timed out
服务设置已更改，请重新读取模型。: Service settings changed. Reload the model list.
服务没有可用模型，请先在模型服务中安装或启用模型。: No models available. Install or enable a model in your model service.
配置服务地址和模型后即可开始对话。支持 OpenAI 兼容接口与本地模型服务。: Configure the service URL and model to start chatting. Supports OpenAI-compatible APIs and local model services.
API Key 环境变量名称（本地服务可留空）: API Key Environment Variable (optional for local services)
支持 OpenAI 兼容 Chat Completions。默认地址用于本地 O: Supports OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions. The default URL is for local Ollama. Configure a model, then click Send.
这里填写环境变量名称，不填写密钥本身。更改系统环境变量后需重启软件。: Enter the environment variable name, not the key itself. Restart after changing system environment variables.
点击标题行展开/收起: Click the header to expand or collapse
请先在首选项中填写模型名称，或在 Agent 设置中读取模型列表。: Set a model name or load the model list in Agent Settings.
服务地址应为 HTTP/HTTPS 基础地址，例如 http://localho: Enter an HTTP/HTTPS base URL, for example http://localhost:11434/v1/.
指定的 API Key 环境变量未设置。请设置后重新启动软件。: The API Key environment variable is not set. Set it and restart the application.
请先在“插件 → Agent”中填写模型名称，或在插件设置中读取模型列表。: Enter a model name under Plugins → Agent or load the model list in plugin settings.
服务未返回有效的对话结果。: The service did not return a valid chat response.
服务返回空内容。请检查模型是否支持 Chat Completions 文本对话。: The service returned empty content. Check whether the model supports text Chat Completions.
服务未返回兼容的模型列表，请手动填写模型名称。: The service did not return a compatible model list. Enter the model name manually.
服务拒绝认证，请检查 API Key 环境变量。: Authentication failed. Check the API Key environment variable.
服务路径或模型不存在，请检查地址和模型名称。: Service path or model not found. Check the URL and model name.
服务请求额度或频率已达到限制。: The service quota or rate limit has been reached.
自动重排场景中所有对象。: Rearrange all objects in the scene.
该模型只有一个连通分量，无需拆分。: This model has only one connected component; no split is needed.
设置文件无法读取，已使用默认值：{0}: Could not read settings; using defaults: {0}
将拆分模型为多个子对象。\n注意：拆分操作默认不可撤销。:
Split the model into multiple objects.
Split operations cannot be undone by default.
